title: Linework: Trace & Draw
shortDescription: Use a camera overlay or lightbox to practise drawing from your own images.
fullDescription:
Choose an image, place your phone securely and follow the overlay on paper. Adjust position and visibility, lock the image in place, or use the lightbox view.

Use a stable stand for camera tracing. This is an overlay drawing aid; it does not project an image onto your paper.
